title: Baklava
instructions: Layer the phyllo sheets with melted butter, adding layers of nuts in between. Bake at 175°C for 50 minutes. Boil sugar, honey, water, vanilla, and lemon zest for syrup. Pour hot syrup over hot baklava. Let cool before serving.

title: Borek
instructions: Sauté the spinach and mix with feta and egg. Fill and roll into yufka sheets brushed with butter. Brush top with egg yolk and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden.

title: Cay
instructions: Boil water in the bottom part of a Turkish teapot. Put tea leaves in the top part and add a little hot water. Let it steep for 10–15 minutes. Pour strong tea first, then dilute with hot water to taste.

title: Kebab
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape onto skewers. Grill over charcoal or in a grill pan until fully cooked.

title: Lahmacun
instructions: Make the dough and let it rise. Mix all filling ingredients. Roll dough into thin circles, spread filling on top, and bake at 220°C for 10 minutes.

title: Meze
instructions: Arrange each meze in small bowls or plates. Serve cold or at room temperature with pita bread.

title: Pide
ingredients: Filling: ground meat, cheese, or vegetables
instructions: Prepare the dough and let rise. Roll into oval shapes, add filling, fold edges, and bake at 220°C for 20 minutes.

title: Simit
instructions: Make the dough and let it rise. Shape into rings, dip in molasses, then sesame seeds. Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
